title: How long can each sea animal get?
prompt: Place each one by the upper length NOAA reports.

items.label: Jonah crab
items.fact: Male Jonah crabs can reach 9 inches, while females are listed up to 6 inches.

items.label: Pygmy killer whale
items.fact: Pygmy killer whales were known only from two fossil skulls until a live animal was discovered in 1954.

items.label: Narwhal
items.fact: Narwhals are listed at 13 to 18 feet long, and calves are about 5.2 feet long at birth.

items.label: Killer whale
items.fact: Killer whales can reach 32 feet and are the largest members of the dolphin family.

items.label: North Atlantic right whale
items.fact: Adult North Atlantic right whales can grow to 52 feet, while calves are about 14 feet at birth.

items.label: Blue whale
items.fact: Antarctic blue whales can reach about 110 feet and are generally larger than other blue whale subspecies.
